question: Tulip Festival is famous in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Srinagar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Tulip Festival** is an annual event organized in **Srinagar**, the capital city of **Jammu and Kashmir** state in India.
 
• The festival is held during the **spring season,** usually in the months of March and April**,** when the tulip gardens in Srinagar are in full bloom.
 
• The festival attracts a** large number of tourists** from all over the world who come to witness the colorful display of tulips in the gardens of Srinagar.
 
• The festival also includes **cultural programs, handicraft exhibitions**, and other activities to showcase the rich cultural heritage of Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agra** is famous for the **Taj Mahal,** a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Wonders of the World. 

 
 
• Agra is also known for its **Mughal-era forts, palaces, and gardens.**
 
• Famous festivals of Agra are **Taj Mahotsav, Ram Barat, and Kailash Fair and Festival.**
 
 
 
• **Allahabad** is a city in the northern state of **Uttar Pradesh**, India.
 
 
• It is famous for the confluence of three rivers, **Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati,** known as Triveni Sangam.
 
• The festivals of **Kumbh Mela, Makar Sakranti, Mahashivratri, and Magh Purnima **are observed in Allahabad when a sizable number of visitors congregate. 
 
 
 
• **Ludhiana** is a city in the northwestern state of **Punjab**, India.
 
 
• It is known for its **textile industry, hosiery goods**, and sports goods manufacturing.
 
• The main celebrations of Ludhiana include** Lohri, Baisakhi, Holi, and Basant Panchami.**
